translations.privacyIntro: This Privacy Policy explains what information this portfolio website collects, why it is collected, and how it is used. By using this site you agree to the practices described below.
translations.privacyCollectContact: {$START_TAG_STRONG}Contact details{$CLOSE_TAG_STRONG} - when you use the contact form, your name, email address, and message are stored so I can read and reply to you.
translations.privacyCollectAccount: {$START_TAG_STRONG}Account details{$CLOSE_TAG_STRONG} - if you sign in with Google or GitHub, I receive your name, email address, and profile picture from that provider to create your account.
translations.privacyCollectFeedback: {$START_TAG_STRONG}Feedback{$CLOSE_TAG_STRONG} - any critique, suggestion, or feature request you post on a project or article is stored and shown publicly alongside your display name.
translations.privacyCollectLocal: {$START_TAG_STRONG}Session data{$CLOSE_TAG_STRONG} - a login token is kept in your browser so you stay signed in. It never leaves your device except to authenticate requests to the backend.
translations.privacyUseBody: Your information is used only to operate this site: to respond to messages, to authenticate you, and to display the feedback you choose to post. I do not sell your data or use it for advertising.
translations.privacyThirdPartyBody: Signing in relies on {$START_LINK}Google{$CLOSE_LINK} and {$START_LINK_1}GitHub{$CLOSE_LINK}, and uploaded images are hosted on {$START_LINK_2}Cloudinary{$CLOSE_LINK}. These providers process data under their own privacy policies.
translations.privacyRightsBody: You can ask me to access, correct, or delete the personal data associated with your account or your messages at any time. Signing out clears the login token from your browser.
translations.privacyContactBody: For any question about this policy or your data, reach me at {$START_LINK}{$INTERPOLATION}{$CLOSE_LINK}.
